Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

one book → two books
One (1)Two or more (2, 3…)
one booktwo books
one boxthree boxes
one phoneten phones
  • More than one? Add -s: book → books, phone → phones.
  • After s, x, ch, sh add -es: box → boxes.
  • Put the number before the noun: two books, ten phones.

→ irregular plurals (child → children) come later.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: one book → two books. Just add -s: phone → phones, year → years.
  • ⚠ After a number English still needs -s: five bookS — not five book (пять книг · бес кітап).

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two short lines: your age and a phone number.

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

I'm twelve years old. My phone number is 555 12 34.

Check yourself:

  • Did you use a number?
  • Did you write I'm … (years old)?
  • Is the phone number clear, digit by digit?
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Hi! I'm Sam. 👋

Sam

Sam

Sam

Sam

Look! I see two dog. 🐶🐶

Why

More than one → add -s: two dogs, three cats, ten phones.

Sam

Yes! “Two dogs.” Great catch. 🌟

Feedback

Well done: you gave your age and phone number, and fixed the plural. Next time, say the numbers out loud too.
